concept.title: The reuse ledger
concept.shortdesc: The reuse ledger records where each conref and key reference went, so you can confirm that a value still changes in one place after the migration.

conbody.p: Before conversion, replaces each conref, key reference, condition and ID with a numbered placeholder and writes it to the ledger. After conversion it checks that every placeholder survived exactly once, then turns each one into its MyST form:

table.title: DITA reuse and its MyST form

row.entry: An include of a shared file
A substitution, also inside code blocks
An only block for each build
An anchor in DITA-OT's form, topicid__elementid

conbody.p: The counts on the run detail must match: conrefs in the source against includes and substitutions in the output.
